title: Skin Cancer Prevention in Men
subtitle: Risk reduction, screening, evidence, and practical prevention related to skin cancer prevention in men.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports UV radiation as the primary cause of skin cancer and the effectiveness of combined sun protection strategies. Emerging evidence suggests that tailored behavioral interventions can improve adherence to prevention measures in men. Limited evidence exists regarding the ideal frequency of professional skin cancer screening, recommending individualized risk assessment.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
